style: 既存の彩色人物画に合わせた腰までの透過画像。肖像・立ち絵で同じ画像を共用。外見・年代は今回の美術設定で、原文の既定情報ではない。

files.prompt_en: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an isolated transparent dialogue character cutout for a Japanese dungeon RPG, delivered as a PNG with genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the person. Single adult character, centered waist-up composition, complete hair silhouette and both hands visible, lower edge below the belt, generous empty transparent margins at both sides and above. Vertical portrait canvas, 1024 by 1536 pixels. Detailed painted game illustration with tactile linen, worn leather and subtle brass, clean readable facial features, muted earth colors, soft warm light from upper left, eye-level three-quarter view. The whole surrounding area is fully empty transparency, including the space beside the shoulders and head. Plain unlettered clothing surfaces. Subject: Ein, a conscientious return-record scribe in his early forties, a slender man with warm brown skin, dark curly hair cut close at the sides, a short carefully trimmed beard, a long thoughtful face and expressive deep brown eyes. His expression is concerned and reflective yet approachable, listening before making a correction. He wears a muted aubergine wool vest over a high-collared oatmeal linen shirt, a plain slate-blue shoulder capelet and a simple brown leather belt. One empty hand rests near his belt, the other is held gently open in a restrained conversational gesture. The plum vest, dark curls and small capelet make a clear, dignified silhouette.
files.prompt_ja: 用途：日本語ダンジョンRPGの透過会話人物画。エイン、帰還記録の書記。40代前半の細身の男性。暖かな褐色の肌、側面を短く整えた濃い巻き毛、短く整えたひげ、思慮深い面長の顔、表情豊かな濃茶の目。訂正を急ぐ前に話を聞く、懸念と思慮があり親しみやすい表情。くすんだ茄子紫の毛織ベスト、襟の高いオートミール色の麻シャツ、無地の青灰色の短い肩掛け、簡素な茶革のベルト。空の片手を帯の近くに置き、もう一方の空の手を控えめに開いて話す。頭と両手が入り、帯の下で自然に終わる1024×1536の縦構図。質感のある彩色人物画、落ち着いた土色、左上からの柔らかい暖色光。衣服は無地。頭や肩の周囲は完全な透過。
